unit: Marked evals only; mark-interval-confined non-overlapping windows; session-level selection/validation. Correlated frames/windows ≠ independent authentication attempts.

decision_semantics.single_frame_approach_a: Approach A PAD-only: native argmax + winning-score gates. FaceNet identity does not invalidate usable FasNet scores. NO_FACE / MULTIPLE_FACES / FasNet ERROR → ERROR; never REAL from missing scores or insufficient evidence.
decision_semantics.median_real: Median of fasnet_real_score_avg over FACE_OK frames with usable FasNet scores (identity ignored for validity) in a non-overlapping window confined to one mark interval. REAL if median >= real_min; SPOOF if median spoof_combined >= 0.85; else UNCERTAIN. n_valid < ceil(window_s) → INVALID.
decision_semantics.majority_vote: Majority of per-frame Approach A PAD states among FasNet-valid frames. REAL-tie → UNCERTAIN. n_valid < ceil(window_s) → INVALID.

methodology_fix: Prior report incorrectly excluded FaceNet identity failures from PAD valid evidence. Corrected: usable single-face FasNet scores always contribute; identity reported separately for e2e auth analysis.

PRINT_20261021T154852Z.label: PRINT
notes: Interval 0 (~auto#44–1249): main photograph test; provisional PRINT.
Intervals 1–2 (~auto#1295–1304 and auto#1309): real face — excluded.
Unmarked records are never loaded (recorder writes marked-only).

REAL_20261021T154119Z.label: REAL
notes: Single marked interval; all marked evals included.

limitations: Only 1 data-bearing SCREEN session(s); need >=2 for independent selection+validation split.
split_info.unit: data-bearing sessions (zero-eval files excluded from split)
